card.name: Digits and splits inside dose tables
card.fires_on: Numeric pieces and partway-through-word pieces in dose tables and section numbers, such as the digit after a decimal point in headings like 7.5 or the middle of clomiphene.

modes.label: Section numbers
modes.description: The last digit of a numbered heading such as 2.1 or 7.5 just before a section title.

modes.label: Dose table numbers
modes.description: Digits or spaces inside weight, age, or dose ranges in dosing tables.

modes.label: Inside drug names
modes.description: Middle pieces of drug names split into several parts.

card.writes: Little clear effect; it suppresses Chinese words for purpose and summary, so it mostly pushes away such heading-like words.
card.plain: It fires on numbers in dosing tables and section numbers, and on the middle of some drug names.
